transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I’m just not eating right anymore. Some days it’s only coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and my pants are getting loose on me.
Have you lost weight recently?
Yeah, I think so. My pants are getting loose, and I’m not really eating much—some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread.
Are you trying to lose weight?
No, not really trying to. I just don’t feel like eating much. Some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and my pants are getting loose.
Do you feel anxious or upset when you think about eating?
I don’t think so. I don’t really get anxious about eating… I just don’t feel hungry much, or I don’t feel like bothering with it.
Are you enjoying things you used to like doing?
Not really. I used to like walking by the lake, and I’d work on these little model kits at home. Now they just sit there, and I look at them like they belong to somebody else.
How much weight do you think you've lost?
I’m not sure exactly. I haven’t weighed myself, but enough that my pants are hanging loose on me now. Maybe several pounds, I guess.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No… I’m not afraid of gaining weight. That’s not really something I think about.
Do you ever eat a lot of food in a short amount of time?
No, not really. It’s more the opposite. I hardly eat right anymore—some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. That’s why my pants are getting loose.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah. I used to like walking by the lake, and I’d work on my little model kits. Now they just sit there. I look at them like they belong to somebody else.
Do you feel sad or down most of the time?
Yeah. Most days I wake up already feeling low… like there’s this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like nothing good is really waiting for me, so I just want to keep my head down and get through it.
Would you say you've lost more than 5% of your body weight over the past month?
I don’t know the exact percent, but I’ve definitely lost weight. I’m hardly eating—some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread—and my pants are hanging loose on me now.
How long have you been feeling sad or down like this?
About five months now. It’s been hanging over me pretty much the whole time.
Do you take pleasure in things that you're doing nowadays?
Not really, no. I used to like walking by the lake, and I’d work on these little model kits at home… but now they just sit there. I look at them like they belong to somebody else.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?
I’m… I’m not sure how to answer that. I don’t think I have anything clear to say about it right now.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy doing?

No, not really. Like I said, I used to enjoy walking by the lake and doing those little model kits, but now I don’t feel anything for them. They just sit there, and it’s like they belong to somebody else.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed or lost interest in activities?
Yeah… definitely longer than two weeks. This has been going on for about five months now, just this depressed feeling hanging over me.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you didn't feel depressed?
Not really. Most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest… like there’s nothing good ahead of me. I just kind of want to keep my head down and get through it.
Would you say your depression is mild, moderate, or severe?
I’d say it’s severe. Since it got bad, I’ve had to lean on my relatives for things like money, rides, and paperwork. I’m not keeping up with basic errands like I used to.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than usual or have trouble sitting still?
Yeah… slower, I think. My family tells me I move like I’m walking through mud. And sometimes when someone asks me something simple, it takes me a while to even answer.
